description: Attach an existing organization channel to an agent, so the channel's events wake it. Find the channel with list_channels. A webhook channel lets callers outside Valet reach the agent. Attaching a channel that is already attached reports it and changes nothing. Slack needs a Slack app and a browser, so for Slack this gives the step to take and attaches nothing. An app takes no organization channels: create its own with create_channel. Returns the organization, agent, and channel, and whether the channel is attached and was already. Requires connecting a Valet account.

channel.description: The organization channel's name, from list_channels.

name.description: The agent's name, as list_services shows it: the agent to attach the channel to.

org_name.description: The Valet organization both belong to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: attach_channel

agent.description: Name of the agent the call acted on.

already.description: True when the agent already held the channel, so nothing changed. Absent when this call attached it.

attached.description: Always true: the agent holds the channel after the call.

channel.description: Name the channel is attached under, which is the name detach_channel takes.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.
Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

step.description: What the person does in a browser to finish attaching the channel, such as authorizing Slack. Returned instead of an attach result; nothing has changed until they do it.

url.description: Address of the page where the person finishes the step. Absent when the page has no address to give.

title: Attach a channel
